newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Staburadze debuts on active stock market.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Staburadze debuts on active stock market.

text.p: Shares in leading Latvian confectionery maker Staburadze began trading on the Riga stock exchange on Tuesday, moving sharply above its nominal price although trade was slight.
The rest of the market was fairly active, with Unibanka on the official list and Daugavpils Chain on the secondary the most active stocks.
Overall market turnover came to 87,701 lats with Unibanka trading 27,911 lats and staying unchanged at 2.31 lats.
Satburadze, which has also joined the official list, ended at 1.21 lats compared with a nominal price of one lat.
Trade in Staburadze came to under 10 lats but there was huge demand of 147,133 shares and only a small 529 shares supply.
The other official list share, Riga Transport Fleet, dipped 15 santimes to 85 on turnover of 5,535 lats.
Daugavpils Chain was again the most active secondary stock, turning over 25,117 lats and falling to 1.05 lats from 1.11.
Other active stocks included the Lode brick factory on trade of 7,895 lats and it fell to 95 santimes from 97.
The Salacgriva '95 firm traded 6,425 lats of shares and also fell, hitting 1.87 lats after 2.20 lats while the Kaija fish cannery was stable at 1.20 lats as it turned over 3,648 lats.
The Riga Yeast plant was active with 2,940 lats of business and rose to 1.96 lats from 1.75 lats.
The Mangali Shipyard stock was slightly higher at 46 santimes versus 44 on trade of 2,530 lats.
